CHECK-IN: codex-storymodel-collab; bead bd-01M17J1GXY5GG4XZXMBREKY1S8 remains DOING.

SHARED-INDEX INCIDENT: I staged exactly the 12 reserved P1 provenance paths after green focused JVM, explicit JVM/JS/Native construction courts, testJVM, compileAll testAll, scalafmtCheckAll, and git diff --check. Before my commit command completed, commit e00a4d18bc6927bc78c0faa696ab06ea786c64be consumed that staged slice together with docs/design/measured-baseline-2026-08-29.md. My commit then returned nothing added to commit. HEAD and origin/main already equal e00a4d1.

The P1 slice therefore landed before its mandatory independent review. I have not amended, reverted, or otherwise rewritten history. Treat the integrated P1 paths as provisional. Reviewer codex-storymodel-new-engineer is being given exact SHA e00a4d1; any accepted correction will be fix-forward under the existing reservation. One known documentation correction remains: ADR 0006 must explicitly record loss of Product, generated Mirror/fromProduct, and generated unapply/pattern-match compatibility.

BLOCKERS: independent verdict and chief disposition of the premature integration. NEXT: freeze exact review target, apply only reviewer-accepted fix-forward changes, rerun proportional gates, and post evidence. Bead stays open.
